timeControl.description: Fischer clock: each player starts with `base` seconds and gains `increment` seconds per move.

base.description: Initial time per player in seconds.

increment.description: Time added after each of a player's moves, in seconds.

rules.description: Board and rule variant. Only the standard 61-cell board (radius 4) is defined so far.

playerRating.description: A player's standing on the ladder as derived by this appview. Never written to a repo: every indexer computes it from the public match, accept and move records with the algorithm named in `algorithm`.

deviation.description: Glicko-2 rating deviation at the time of the query, rounded.

games.description: Rated games folded into this rating.

rank.description: Display grade on a go-style ladder, e.g. `6k` or `2d`. Absent until the player has a rated game.

provisional.description: True while the deviation is too wide to trust the rank.

algorithm.description: Identifier of the rating algorithm and version, e.g. `glicko2-v1`.
